dict.string: Capture a signature from paper to place in your PDF.
Butter Paper saves the files you make, such as Word documents and signed copies, beside your PDFs in Downloads.
Butter Paper saves the files you make, such as Word documents and signed copies, beside your PDFs in Documents.
Butter Paper saves the files you make, such as Word documents and signed copies, beside your PDFs on the Desktop.
Butter Paper saves the files you make, such as Word documents and signed copies, beside your PDFs on removable drives.
Butter Paper saves the files you make, such as Word documents and signed copies, beside your PDFs on network drives.
Butter Paper asks Microsoft Word to convert a PDF only when you choose Convert and Open in Word.
